prompt: Who is the only female artist to have topped Spotify's list of most-streamed artists in three consecutive years (2020–2022)?
answer: No female artist topped Spotify’s list in 2020–2022. Bad Bunny topped it those three years; Taylor Swift was the only female artist to top the list, in 2023–2024.
